display_name: Phase1 physical mixture source weight diagnostic
description: Diagnose posterior weight concentration, controller change, and fixed-hypothesis pseudo-label coverage on explored source RX8 records.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU3 source-only fixed inference, CPU two threads, TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Ungated six posterior IQ states, posterior weights, learned corrections and source clean-F pseudo targets
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No L_s or U_s truth; only frozen clean F pseudo targets, no V or test
data.validation_ref: 384 fixed RX8 source heldout IDs, 64 per impaired view; previously explored, no true-label evaluation
data.leo_config_ref: Fresh source cache epoch21/22/23 training; source cache epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: Previously explored source RX8 cache and frozen clean F pseudo targets only; no true identity labels, U_s truth, V or test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-trained mixture controller and six-component blind source posterior; frozen F; no DURA inference
